Subject: Feedback on Recent Stay - Exceptional Service

Dear Hotel Manager,

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service I experienced during my recent stay at your hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction.

I would like to specifically highlight the efforts of [Employee Name 1] at the front desk, who was incredibly welcoming and efficient during check-in, and [Employee Name 2] in housekeeping, who maintained the highest standards of cleanliness and attention to detail throughout my visit. Their professionalism and kindness truly made my stay memorable.

Given the high quality of service and hospitality provided, I would not hesitate to recommend your hotel to my peers and colleagues. I look forward to returning in the future.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Contact Information]
